result: Brainspotting can fall on either side of this boundary. A resource-oriented or carefully titrated session can prepare you for deeper work, whereas entering highly charged developmental material is a different dose. With diffuse relational trauma, I sometimes think EMDR fits better after at least some inner-child reparenting, since access to a Nurturer and Protector gives you something to hold the material with. A stable person working on a single discrete event may not need a long preliminary sequence at all.
